propositions: BindingRepository must preserve exact byte layout (sorted, indented, trailing newline) when round-tripping legacy and unknown-field fixtures without eager write on construction
Unconditional save must attempt rotation persistence before live replacement, and rotation tempfile/write/replace failure leaves rotation old, live new with inline floor, without raising
After rotation failure, the next successful save must write the retained inline floor to the sidecar before live replacement (two-save fault/recovery convergence)
Corrupt live JSON raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired JSON returns empty, preserves the file, and attempts deduped alert with swallowed failure
Retired and live tempfile/write/replace failures preserve old files, clean temps, and raise; live failure after successful rotation/retired writes retains the earlier state-file result
Alert persistence failure is swallowed and does not alter successful state-file results
